description: Console header: U0TXD, U0RXD, GND for each board
notes: SIX pins, not ten. EN and IO0 are NOT available: the vendor's board definition accounts for every pin on the ESP32-S3-Matrix's two header rows (3 power + 17 GPIO) and neither appears. They exist on the board - IO0 under the BOOT button, EN on the reset circuit - but reaching them means soldering to the dev board, which ends its life as a swappable module. This is the THIRD line of defence anyway: OTA rollback first, then USB-Serial-JTAG through the tail USB-C slot (which is why USB MIDI is opt-in), then this. A corrupted BOOTLOADER ends the instrument; that is accepted
